note: v463: Account separation is now automatic — no 'Check all 12 months' chore. When you open the Statements page (or switch accounts), the app quietly learns your other accounts' transactions in the background, so a business record that clears the business account stops showing up as unmatched (and stops being suggested under 'Find any record') while you reconcile your personal account. The current account's suggestions now stick to the current account.
